name: OmaGram
author: TerrifiedBug
description: Telegram in the Omarchy bar: unread badge, desktop notifications, inline reply, and a one-key jump to Telegram Desktop.

barWidget.description: Telegram chats, unread badge, and inline reply.

schema.label: Daemon socket path (blank = default)
schema.description: Unix socket the panel talks to. Blank uses $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/omarchy-omagram.sock, which is what the bundled systemd unit creates.

schema.label: Start the daemon automatically
schema.description: Starts omarchy-omagram.service the first time the panel cannot reach the socket. Turn this off if you manage the unit yourself.

schema.label: Show unread count next to the icon
schema.description: Draws the unread total beside the Telegram glyph. Muted and archived chats never count.

schema.label: Hide the widget when there is nothing unread
schema.description: Collapses the widget while the unread total is zero, so the bar only shows it when something needs attention.

schema.label: Chats listed in the panel
schema.description: How many chats the panel lists, up to the 60 the daemon broadcasts.

schema.label: Messages loaded per conversation
schema.description: How far back the conversation view reads when a chat is opened.

schema.label: Window class/title pattern used to focus Telegram Desktop
schema.description: Matched against Hyprland window class and title to decide whether Telegram Desktop is already running before launching it.

schema.label: Command that launches Telegram Desktop
schema.description: Run when no window matches the pattern above. Change it if your Telegram binary is named differently or lives in a Flatpak.

schema.label: Use Telegram Web at this URL instead of Telegram Desktop (blank = desktop)
schema.description: Set to https://web.telegram.org/k/ to open Telegram Web as a webapp window instead of the desktop client.
